note: Transcribed Oct 1 from Brett's GHIN Scorecards screen recording (Sep 30, 9:07 pm), every row June 1 → Sep 30 2026. `posted` is the score GHIN shows; `diff` is GHIN's differential. `adjGross` is the whole score that reproduces `diff` with Loop's scoreDifferential() (gross − rating) × 113 / slope; where it is below `posted`, GHIN applied a hole cap or PCC. `totalOnly` = GHIN tagged it Total Score (no hole-by-hole card). `date` is the day played; where GHIN shows a different day it is kept as `ghinDate` (Brett, Oct 1: Shot Pattern's dates are the play dates). Hole-by-hole cards: every round from Jun 17 on is a Shot Pattern card in src/seedRounds.js (Oct 1; Ironwood is a Loop round). Bear Slide 6/10 and Cider Ridge 6/6 predate Shot Pattern's round history, so they have no card yet and are not in History. Where a card's total differs from `posted` (Mill/School 7/17: card 80, GHIN 81; Woodmont 6/27: 85 vs 84; Woodmont 6/17: 81 vs 80) the seed keeps both. The last row (May 16, the oldest in the recording) is before June; it is here only because the June ghosts' last-5 reach back to it (src/seedRounds.js `ghostDiff`).
